ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law No. 80 of 2016 on Combating Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing, as amended by Law No. 114 of 2022; Executive Regulations of Law No. 80 of 2016 (as amended); Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 (as amended, including mandatory UBO register provisions) and its Executive Regulations; Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 and its Executive Regulations; beneficial ownership register implementing decisions and GAFI circulars issued by the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI); binding AML/CFT instructions and guidance of the Egyptian Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Combating Unit (EMLCU).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport or national ID issuing authority of the beneficial owner's home country

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-country Companies Registry or equivalent official registrar
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization at the Embassy or Consulate of Egypt in the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified corporate resolution authorizing execution of the Egyptian LLC's Articles of Association and the Power of Attorney to the founding legal representative

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Ministry of Justice-licensed sworn translator and Egyptian Notary Public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Domestic notarization in Egypt (no consular step required for the Arabic original)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, directors, managers, UBOs and authorized signatories against the UN Security Council consolidated sanctions list, OFAC SDN list, EU and UK consolidated financial sanctions lists, Egypt's domestic terrorist and money laundering lists issued under Law 80/2016, and a global PEP database. Politically exposed persons, whether foreign or domestic, with their family members and close associates, trigger Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) requiring senior management approval, documented source of wealth and funds, and continuous transaction monitoring. Any match or suspicion must be reported to the EMLCU under the statutory suspicion report (STR) framework within the statutory deadline.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: GAFI One-Stop-Shop (OSS) - Egypt Company Name Search and Reservation System at gafi.gov.eg, operated by the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones; name records are cross-checked against the Egyptian Commercial Registry central database and the Arabic Chamber of Commerce trademark watch list.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Under Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 and GAFI practice, the statutory company name must be in Arabic script; a parallel Latin-script (English) transliteration may be registered as the foreign name provided it is a faithful transliteration and is not confusingly similar to any existing registered name. The Arabic name is authoritative for all Commercial Registry and notarial filings; misleading, generic, duplicate, or trademark-infringing names are refused.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Arab (where implying official Arab League or state affiliation)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the proposed name is refused, GAFI issues written reasons; the incorporator may file an administrative appeal with the GAFI First-Tier Complaints Committee within 30 calendar days of the refusal, then with the GAFI higher Complaints Committee, and may ultimately challenge an adverse decision before the Administrative Court under Article 13 of Investment Law No. 72 of 2017. A single extension of the initial 60-day reservation may be requested through the OSS before expiry; an expired reservation requires a fresh application and fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible as the sole registered seat. Law No. 159 of 1981 and commercial registration practice require a physical Egyptian head office capable of receiving service of process, maintaining statutory records, and sustaining the supervised business activity. For the ISIC 2670 precision optical lens and camera module manufacturing scope, a leased or owned premises with commercial or industrial character, utilities registration and physical signage is mandatory; a virtual mailing address may be used only as an ancillary correspondence address.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High - approximately 70% likelihood of at least one unannounced on-site inspection within the first 12 months of incorporation, driven by sample-based verification of registered offices and commercial substance by GAFI, the Egyptian Commercial Registry, and the Egyptian Tax Authority.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Egypt Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 as amended (LLC provisions: Articles 1, 17, 21, 26-40, 100-113); Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 (Articles 1, 22, 24); Executive Regulations of the Companies Law issued by Prime Minister's Decree No. 261 of 2014; Commercial Registry Law and Executive Regulations; Civil Code provisions on contracts (Articles 89-95).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Egyptian General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) - One-Stop Shop (Department of Companies Law and Commercial Registration), operated jointly with the Commercial Registry, the Egyptian Tax Authority, and the Notary Public Administration.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Incorporation Application and Notarized Articles of Association (Aqd Al-Ta'sis), filed on the GAFI One-Stop Shop portal and physically deposited at the GAFI Companies Registration Department for issuance of the Commercial Registration Certificate.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for an LLC under Law No. 159 of 1981, but the founding quota capital must be adequate for the stated manufacturing objective and fully subscribed with each cash contribution deposited in a temporary bank escrow account opened in the proposed company name, released only after issuance of the Commercial Registration Certificate; in-kind contributions must be supported by a certified auditor valuation and recorded in the notarized contract.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, at the first constitutional meeting of the founding shareholders of [COMPANY] LLC held on this date: (1) That the total share capital of EGP [AMOUNT] be subscribed and issued to the persons listed in Annex A, each accepting the quotas allocated and transferring the corresponding cash subscriptions to the company's temporary bank account at [BANK] to be released after Commercial Registration. (2) That the registered office be established at [ADDRESS], Cairo, the Arab Republic of Egypt, as the company's official seat for notices, service, and tax purposes. (3) That [MANAGER] be appointed General Manager with sole management and banking authority, and [OFFICER] be appointed Corporate Secretary responsible for filings and compliance. (4) That the General Manager be authorized to execute all incorporation filings.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Reservation and Commercial Name Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI One-Stop Shop Name Reservation Window (online: investing.gafi.gov.eg) and the Commercial Registry.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit three proposed Arabic trade names reflecting the activity 'Manufacture of Precision Optical Glass Lenses and Camera Modules' with an English equivalent. The name must not conflict with existing trademarks or a reserved Commercial Registry name. Obtain preliminary name reservation certificate valid for 60 days.
required_dossiers: Copy of founding shareholders' national ID or passport
Brief dossier stating planned industrial activity (ISIC 2670)
Owner disclosure form where a foreign shareholder holds more than 25%
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is objected to, file a corrected reservation with alternate names free of charge; a rejection may be administratively appealed to the GAFI legal department within 15 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Notarization of the Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public Office affiliated with the Court of Appeal (Cairo/Alexandria) or the GAFI Notary Office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Cause the corporate counsel to draft the Articles of Association in Arabic covering quotas, capital, management rules, registered office, corporate object, and liquidation provisions. Arrange signature by all founding shareholders and deposit the executed instrument for notarization with the Notary Public; obtain the notary certified copy.
required_dossiers: Statement from legal counsel on lawful corporate object
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Notarial queries are cured by amending the identified clauses and re-depositing within 5 working days; failure to cure leads to rejection requiring a fresh execution of signatures.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Capital Deposit in Temporary Bank Escrow and In-Kind Valuation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Authorized commercial bank in Egypt (licensed by the Central Bank of Egypt).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary escrow account in the proposed company name and transfer cash quotas. Where machinery or equipment contributes toward capital, have a certified auditor issue a valuation statement attached to the Articles. Keep deposit evidence showing 100% of paid cash capital until incorporation completion.
required_dossiers: Bank account application and certified deposit receipt
Certified auditor valuation report for in-kind contributions
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests KYC remediation, deliver Enhanced Due Diligence packs on beneficial owners and source of funds; delayed release is remedied by presenting the Commercial Registration Certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: GAFI One-Stop Incorporation Filing and Commercial Registration Issuance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI One-Stop Shop - Companies Registration and Commercial Registry Departments.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the full incorporation package via the GAFI digital portal and physically at the GAFI headquarters service center. Upon review and fee payment, GAFI issues the company's Commercial Registration Certificate (Shahadat al-Qayd al-Tijari), the incorporation decision, and coordinates simultaneous issuance of the provisional tax card.
required_dossiers: Founders' KYC forms and address certificates
Declaration of company activity and workplace address
Payment of government incorporation fees and stamp duty
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where a correction notice is issued, cure the deficiencies within ten working days and re-file; under Law No. 72 of 2017, silence beyond the legal period creates a deemed approval but a formal expediting request should be filed in parallel.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration and National Social Insurance Enrollment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) at the GAFI Service Center and the National Organization for Social Insurance (NOSI).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: At the GAFI post-incorporation counter, complete the corporate tax registration (Tax Card), register for Value Added Tax if expected annual supplies exceed the registration threshold or voluntarily to reclaim input VAT on industrial machinery, and register with NOSI for employer and employee social insurance within two weeks of hiring employees.
required_dossiers: Workplace address proof and lease/ownership deed
Board resolution appointing tax comptroller and signatories
Payroll and employee data for NOSI registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Repeated ETA desk objections are resolved by attending the GAFI tax desk with the corporate file and paying disputed stamp fees; NOSI late registration is cured by paying minor delay fines and submitting corrected payroll registers.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Chamber of Commerce and Foreign Trade Exporter Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Federation of Egyptian Chambers of Commerce (Cairo Chamber) and the General Organization for Export and Import Control (GOEIC).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the LLC in the Commercial Registry's chamber of commerce membership records and, given the optics export model, obtain the importer/exporter card and register with GOEIC for export nomenclature classification and shipment inspection requirements on precision lenses.
required_dossiers: Manager's ID and trade authorization letter
List of product HS codes (HS 9001, HS 9002, HS 8529 for camera modules)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: For GOEIC data mismatches, amend the Commercial Registry data first, then re-submit the exporter file; a rejected registration can be corrected and re-filed with supporting certificates of origin issued afterwards.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Industrial Development Authority (IDA), Ministry of Trade and Industry, for issuance of industrial facility licenses under the Unified Industrial Licensing Law (Law No. 15 of 2017 and its implementing decrees).
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Industrial Operating License for Manufacture of Precision Optical Instruments and Photography Equipment (Licensed Activity Code: 2670), covering establishment, operation, and development of the industrial facility.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA), Ministry of Environment
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B (EIA Screening and Initial Environmental Impact Assessment required) for optical lens polishing, grinding, chemical coating, and solvent cleaning lines that generate effluents, VOC emissions, and hazardous polishing wastes; activities adjacent to sensitive zones require a full EIA report.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharge to public sewer: pH 6-9.5, BOD <= 600 mg/L, COD <= 1100 mg/L, TSS <= 800 mg/L, oil and grease <= 100 mg/L per Ministry of Housing Decree No. 298 of 2012; discharge to surface watercourses under Law No. 48 of 1982 (BOD <= 60 mg/L, COD <= 80 mg/L, TSS <= 50 mg/L). Air emissions: organic solvent and VOC abatement with capture efficiency >= 90% and particulate filtration meeting ambient PM10 150 microg/m3 (24-hour) limits under Law No. 4 of 1994 as amended by Law No. 9 of 2009; hazardous waste (spent polishing slurries, cerium oxide residues, solvent waste) must be stored in approved containers and disposed of through EEAA-licensed waste contractors under Hazardous Waste Regulations of Decree No. 963 of 2015.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Civil Defense Authority (Ministry of Interior) fire safety clearance and operating fire certificate; municipality structural load inspection certificate for the production hall and annexes; Ministry of Manpower workplace occupational safety and health clearance under Labor Law No. 12 of 2003 including noise exposure assessment (8-hour TWA <= 85 dBA), machine guarding, eye protection for polishing lines, chemical hygiene for coating solvents, and first aid and emergency evacuation plans.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), Ministry of Finance, Arab Republic of Egypt; unified taxpayer e-services portal: https://www.eta.gov.eg; mandatory e-invoicing/e-receipt fiscal clearance portal: https://invoicing.eta.gov.eg
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Procedure for an EG_LLC controlled by non-residents: after incorporation through the General Authority for Investment (GAFI), the LLC performs one-time unified tax registration at the ETA portal. Steps: (1) file the notarized articles of association, electronic commercial-registry excerpt, investment licence and applicant identification; (2) appoint a local tax file administrator and grant a notarized power of attorney; (3) obtain the statutory unified Tax Identification Number (TIN) certificate and corporate income-tax registration simultaneously; (4) activate the ETA e-invoicing API credentials (client-ID, client secret, digital signature certificate) and e-receipt profile; (5) apply for VAT registration at initial registration, which is mandatory when aggregate taxable supplies reach EGP 500,000 within any 12-month period and is required on the first export transaction to benefit from zero-rating and input VAT refund. A local ETA-qualified tax representative is strongly recommended where non-resident directors do not travel to Egypt.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Egyptian law does not provide a check-the-box election or a hybrid-mismatch pass-through regime; LLCs are taxable as separate juridical persons. Elections available to the optics-manufacturing LLC include: (i) voluntary early VAT and e-invoicing registration from the first export contract; (ii) consolidated corporate tax filing for affiliated Egyptian companies with at least 95% direct or indirect ownership under Law 38 of 2024; (iii) unilateral and bilateral advance pricing agreement (APA) options with the ETA; (iv) election of an approved foreign-currency translation method for export proceeds where consented to by the ETA.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) — Egyptian Law No. 67 of 2016 as amended by the unified tax package Law No. 38 of 2024
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EGP 500,000 aggregate taxable turnover of goods and services in any rolling 12-month period; registration is required at first export transaction even below the threshold to claim zero-rating and refunds
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: All VAT-registered suppliers must issue e-invoices in JSON/XML through the ETA REST API and obtain real-time fiscal clearance before transmission to customers. The ETA returns a QR-coded fiscal identifier, rejects non-conforming invoices and maintains a transaction log cross-linked to customs declarations. Since 2023/2024, the e-receipt obligation has been phased in for all B2C sales. An uncleared invoice is treated as not issued: input VAT deduction is blocked for the buyer and per-invoice penalties apply.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies when (i) tangible goods, here precision optical lenses and camera modules, are physically exported from Egyptian customs territory, (ii) the supplier holds a valid customs export declaration, and (iii) export proceeds are received in convertible currency. International transport and auxiliary logistics services rendered in connection with the exported goods also qualify for 0%. Any domestic supply, installation or services consumed in Egypt remain taxable at 14%.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (official C87/export manifest) stamped by the Egyptian Customs Authority with the relevant HS code
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical dispatch from Egyptian customs territory
Inward Remittance Certificate issued by an Egyptian licensed bank, matching the SWIFT credit advice with the exported invoice value
Commercial invoice, packing list and purchase order or letter of credit describing the optical goods
Certificate of origin and inspection conformity report where required by the destination market
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The ETA validates zero-rating against the e-invoice register, customs CIB export records, shipping manifests and bank inward-transfer evidence. If the FOB value is not repatriated within 180 days or an ETA-approved extension, the transaction is retroactively re-characterized as taxable at 14%, with delay interest from the original due date. Fraudulent claims, sham declarations, circular FX transfers and overstated export values are punished by clawback of the zero-rated benefit for up to five prior years, fines between 100% and 200% of the evaded tax, suspension of the e-invoice clearance profile and TIN, bank-account attachment under Law 38 of 2024, and imprisonment of the responsible manager or signatories under the tax evasion provisions of the VAT law.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) — Foreign Exchange Regulation Sector and Banking Supervision Sector; powers derived from Central Bank and Banking System Law No. 88 of 2003, as amended by Law No. 194 of 2020, and the Anti-Money Laundering Law No. 80 of 2002.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: EGP is accepted as current-account convertible under Egypt's IMF Article VIII obligations; capital-account transactions, including FDI equity injections and profit remittances, remain subject to CBE registration and licensed-bank intermediation. Egypt has unified the official exchange rate to close the parallel-market spread, but banks still apply internal FX liquidity controls. Dividend and profit remittances require: (i) CBE-registered direct investment in the capital records of the LLC, (ii) Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) tax clearance confirming payment of all corporate and dividend taxes, (iii) audited financial statements evidencing distributable reserves, and (iv) execution through an onshore licensed bank via SWIFT MT103. No standing blockage on profit transfers exists, but settlement windows, documentation reviews, and bank-level foreign-currency deferral mechanisms can delay outflows by several days.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under CBE consolidated exchange-control instructions for non-oil exporters, the optical lens manufacturer must negotiate export collections through a licensed Egyptian bank and repatriate the full proceeds to its onshore foreign-exchange retention account within the earlier of the commercial credit period or a statutory maximum collection window currently capped at 4 months from the date of loading/negotiation (extendable to 270 days with bank-justified documentary support). The mandatory hard conversion ratio for export receipts into EGP is currently zero — exporters may retain 100% of export proceeds in foreign currency — provided that the bank receives, per shipment: the ACI/NAFEZA advance cargo notification, customs export declaration, bill of lading/airway bill, commercial invoice, and the FCReceipt/negotiation form. Failure to meet the repatriation timeline triggers automatic inclusion on the CBE exporter default list, suspension of import-financing facilities, and customs clearance restrictions.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (Investment Law 72/2017) + Operational EGP Account + FX Retention Account
Capital Escrow Account + Operational EGP Account + FX Retention Account
Capital Escrow Account + Operational EGP Account + FX Retention Account
Capital Escrow Account + Operational EGP Account + FX Retention Account + Trade Finance LC Lines
Capital Escrow Account + Operational EGP Account + FX Retention Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW for onshore settlement; MEDIUM-LOW for auxiliary offshore use. Legal constraints: CBE Law 194/2020 and Fintech Law 18/2019 require any entity providing payment, wallet, or remittance services in Egypt to hold a CBE fintech or payment-service license; therefore, offshore digital EMIs such as Revolut Business, Wise Business, Payoneer, or Paysera cannot open EGP accounts, issue Egyptian IBANs, or participate in local clearing. They may be used only as off-cycle USD/EUR collection nodes outside Egypt, and funds so collected must be swept back to the Egyptian corporate account via licensed banks to satisfy CBE trade-file reporting and export-proceeds repatriation rules. Capital injections, export receipts, and supplier payments must never bypass the EGP banking system.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence and in-person KYC interviews are effectively mandatory for non-resident shareholders, ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs), and authorized signatories of a new foreign-owned LLC classified as Medium-Risk Enhanced. Banks require: original passports, certified copy of the LLC contract, notarized board resolutions, apostilled or legalized corporate documents from the jurisdiction of the UBO, source-of-wealth statements, and a signed compliance declaration. Remote opening is generally not permitted for an optics-exporter without an existing relationship; in exceptional cases, a bank may accept videographic UBO verification if the UBO completes similar KYC at a foreign correspondent bank, supported by original documents retained by that correspondent and a formal enterprise-request waiver approved by the CBE.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident UBO concentration in a high-risk trade route (GCC/HK financing intermediaries and Chinese beneficial owners in an optics exporter)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified Arabic commercial registry and LLC contract, apostilled UBO declarations and passport copies, source-of-wealth and source-of-funds narratives supported by 12 months of UBO bank statements, audited financials of the ultimate parent, and bank reference letters from the UBOs' principal relationship banks.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Dual-use optics/camera surveillance scope triggers sanctioned-goods screening and enhanced monitoring filters
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Product technical sheets for commercial lens modules under HS 9002/9002.90 with stated civilian end-uses, ISO 9001:2015 certification, end-user declarations excluding defense applications, a compliance policy prohibiting military customers, and classification acknowledgment from the bank's trade-control officer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Newly formed LLC with minimal charter capital yet first-year projected export revenue materially exceeding equity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: GAFI investment certificate and capital filing, notarized capital contribution resolution, multi-year distribution and offtake agreements with reputable non-sanctioned customers, two-year audited or management-prepared budget, and a letter of comfort or parent guarantee from the UBO.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large same-day FX wire batches to overseas suppliers without matching customs and ACI filings
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Per-shipment evidence bundle: NAFEZA ACI advance cargo declaration number, final customs release, bill of lading or airway bill, commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of origin, the negotiating bank's export-proceeds form, and a signed undertaking to remit final settlement proof within the statutory 4-month collection window.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: PEP or politically exposed person identified as UBO or authorized signatory
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: PEP declaration and enhanced-monitoring consent, credible source-of-wealth evidence, an Egyptian counsel legal opinion confirming no governmental procurement interest in the LLC, designation of a qualified compliance officer within the company, and acceptance of quarterly PEP account reviews.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity must be wired by SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder's own bank account (third-party settlement and cash deposits are prohibited). Field 70 'Remittance Information' must state 'EQUITY SUBSCRIPTION — CAPITAL INCREASE — DIRECT INVESTMENT UNDER EGYPT LAW 72/2017' with the receiving bank mapping the transaction to the CBE balance-of-payments direct-investment code for equity capital. The funds are credited to a segregated Capital Escrow Account and verified against: (i) the LLC's notarized capital increase resolution, (ii) the GAFI-issued investment certificate, (iii) confirmation of the source-of-funds questionnaire, and (iv) the bank's cross-check with the CBE electronic investment registry. After verification, the bank issues a receipt-of-online-remittance certificate acceptable to the ETA and the Cairo notary public for updating the paid-in capital; funds may thereafter be converted to the CBE-approved parallel rate and transferred to the operating account only for documented project expenditures.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary clearing rails for trade settlement: (1) SWIFT MT103 (TT/wire) for raw-material imports (optical glass blanks, chemical coatings, packaging) using CBE BoP trade-purpose code 5110; the Egyptian importer must hold a valid tax card, active commercial register, and the ACI/NAFEZA advance cargo registration number per shipment, and the bank marries the wire to the customs declaration before release. (2) Commercial Letters of Credit issued under UCP600 — sight LC for capital machinery and 30- to 60-day term LC for component blanks — advised through the supplier's correspondent bank; the issuing Egyptian bank files the documentary inward bill package with the CBE trade statistics and the NAFEZA single window. (3) For urgent disbursements to verified suppliers, DD/DA or open-account terms are permitted but increase the export-proceeds reconciliation burden and require pre-approved counterparty credit lines. All payments are blocked without the GOEIC import registration certificate for regulated goods, and payments to Iranian, Syrian, North Korean, or sanctioned Russian parties are prohibited under CBE instructions and international sanctions.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable outright FX forwards (EGP/USD and EGP/EUR) with licensed Egyptian banks, tenors of up to 180 days, executable only against documented physical trade flows.
FX swaps (spot sale against forward purchase) for providing EGP liquidity to the operating account while preserving retained USD/EUR export balances.

Cross-currency swaps (CCIRS) for long-term foreign-currency project financing from development finance institutions or offshore investment banks, subject to CBE prior approval and real asset-liability exposure.

Plain-vanilla FX options (EGP call / USD put) in restricted conditions, with 12-month maximum maturity, only from CBE-licensed domestic banks, and with the premium settled in EGP from the operating account.

Offshore NDFs are NOT permissible onshore; the Egyptian LLC must not book nondeliverable forward contracts with offshore counterparties because such positions jeopardize CBE compliance standing and the availability of trade finance lines.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return and Audited Financial Statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months after the fiscal year-end (a 31 December year-end return is due by 30 April of the following year); financial statements annexed to the return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of 2% of tax due per month (capped at 100% of tax due); failure to file may be challenged by ETA estimative assessment and enforced through administrative collection; does not trigger corporate strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) Confirmation and Shareholder Register Update
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI)/Financial Regulatory Authority (FRA) AML Unit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days of any transfer of shares by the annual confirmation date; if no transfer, the annual confirmation is due with the annual financial statements no later than 31 March
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-compliance with AML Law No. 80/2002 as amended invokes fines ranging from EGP 100,000 to EGP 500,000 and possible suspension of entity registrations.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Egyptian Commercial Registry (Department of the Ministry of Trade and Industry / GAFI)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the registration anniversary date, with a 30-day grace period
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A monthly surcharge of 2% applies after the grace period; a lapse exceeding 6 months may result in administrative strike-off of the company from the Commercial Registry.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Egyptian LLCs are required to engage a licensed auditor if paid-up capital exceeds EGP 250,000 or if the number of shareholders exceeds 10; under Law 148/2019, all investment-law-supervised companies are required to arrange annual statutory audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS) in conformity with IFRS/IAS; tax accounting adjustments mandated under Egyptian Income Tax Law 91/2005.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: LLC must keep a dedicated UBO register and file an annual confirmatory statement with GAFI/FRA. Any change in shareholding requires a register update and, if the UBO changes, a notification to GAFI within 15 days. The annual confirmation must be signed by the manager and certified by the external auditor where a statutory audit is required.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Security/Encumbrance Register (if any pledges over shares)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 350 - USD 900 for registered office, corporate secretary, and monthly compliance monitoring
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 700 - USD 2,800 depending on transaction volume and group structure
